references.text: Repeats the principle that the avenger of blood shall kill the murderer when he meets him
Explains the avenger of blood's right to kill the murderer if he leaves a city of refuge
Warns against the avenger of blood, in his anger, pursuing and killing someone who killed accidentally
The elders must hand over a murderer to the avenger of blood so that he may die
Describes the purpose of the cities of refuge as protection from the avenger of blood
Refers to the avenger of blood in connection with protecting someone in danger
The fundamental principle that whoever sheds human blood shall have their own blood shed
